Title: Public preview: Azure Log Analytics in France Central, Korea Central, North Europe

Body.Content:
Azure Log Analytics is part of Azure Monitor. It collects telemetry from a variety of sources and uses the query language from Azure Data Explorer to retrieve and analyze data.

Azure Log Analytics is available for preview in three new regions: France Central, Korea Central, and North Europe.

You can learn more about Log Analytics here and explore additional regional availability.
